snippet.title: MVP Career: Golf - VR Golf Game on Meta Quest
snippet.description:
Your Career. Your Swing. Your Legacy.

Step into the world of MVP Career: Golf, an immersive virtual reality golf game built for Meta Quest that takes the sport beyond the traditional golf course.

Start your journey as an aspiring golfer and work your way toward becoming a legend. Master your swing, compete in tournaments, challenge your friends, climb the leaderboards, and build your professional golfing career.

⛳ GAME FEATURES:
- In-depth Story Mode featuring 21 chapters across 7 acts
- Immersive VR golf swing mechanics
- Dynamic driving ranges with randomized targets
- Tour Mode featuring changing course layouts, pars, and putting
- Mini Golf with randomized layouts
- Competitive ranked gameplay
- Online multiplayer with friends
- Global leaderboards
- Career progression and staff management
- Dynamic weather and wind conditions
- Passthrough driving range experience

Whether you're a casual golfer, a competitive player, or someone looking for a new VR sports experience, MVP Career: Golf offers something for every skill level.

🏆 Don't just play golf. Build your legacy.

📅 Release Date: December 10, 2026
🎮 Platform: Meta Quest
🔥 Available for pre-order now!

🌐 Official Website: https://mvpcareer.com/

Developed by PWNED Studio as part of the MVP Career gaming universe.

Subscribe for gameplay videos, development updates, new features, and upcoming MVP Career games.
